work.title: Il giudicio di Paride, drama per musica. Da cantarsi per le felicissime nozze di sua maestà Cristiano VII e Carolina Matilde
Das Urtheil des Paris, ein Singgedicht. Welches an dem höchsterfreulichen Vermählungsfeste Königs Christian des Siebten und Caroline Mathildis

history.p: Though there had been some problems between Scheibe and the court concerning the payment of fees in connection with Frederik V's funeral in early 1766, the dispute must have been solved since Scheibe was asked to compose the music for the official celebration of the marriage between Christian VII and Caroline Mathilde in the autumn. The newspapers include extensive descriptions of the event which started already at 10 o'clock in the morning and were to continue for several days. As on other occasions Scheibe's chorale setting of 'I Jesu Navn' (SchW B3:002) was also performed in the royal church for the wedding ceremony, and for the official banquet at the palace in the evening Scheibe had composed 'magnificent music' for the orchestra consisting of eighty musicians. Part of the music was the present festive cantata composed to a text by Leopoldo di Villati on the theme of Paris’ judgement which was the subject of the celebration. It should be noted that Scheibe’s acquaintance, the composer Carl Heinrich Graun, had already written a wedding cantata in 1752 employing the same text which was printed in 1757. It is possible that Scheibe had been inspired by Graun’s work.

annot.p: 'Saasnart de Høy-Kongelige Herskaber i Ridder-Salen vare indkomne begyn[d]tes strax med Pauker og Trompetter og continueredes dermed indtil Tegn af Ober-Hof-Marskallen blev givet at opholde. Over Taffelet opførtes en af Capelmester Scheibe componeret prægtig Musik, bestaaende af 80ve Musicis.'

incipText.p: Messagiero di Giove a te me vengo
Ich, der Bothe Jupiters, komme zu dir
Non ti lusinghi il vano splendor dell' oro
Laß dich nicht den eitlen Glanz des Goldes verblenden
E' il sapere quel gran Bene
Se vedrai que' begli occhi lucenti
Wenn du sehen wirst, daß jene schönen und glänzenden Augen
(Tutto occupate il cor, o sdegni miei)
Der Zorn nimmt mein Herz ganz ein
Ich besitze den Ruhm der Schönheit
Geliebter Paris! ich sehe, du erblassest
Dir verspreche ich ein erkenntliches Herz
Or tu vedesti, o bella Regina
